note: Admin-plane values resolved by the harness at run start. The silent mutations in the slot's drift record move these keys and nothing announces the move. The agent-visible surface carries the values in force at delivery.
_step_budget_note: The step budget is set by the scale of THIS SLOT'S delivered corpus and not by the record set's 3250 steps. The corpus is a few tens of kilobytes of authored raw web text, so a single 524288-token step already covers it many times over and the substrate's 3.28 target is not reachable at this corpus scale. What the budget buys is a real training run of the frozen decoder whose held-out loss is ordered by the quality of the curated stream, which is the quantity this slot grades. Raising it to the record set's operating point requires staging a raw corpus at FineWeb scale, which is a corpus-authoring change and not a re-base one; the shortfall is recorded as gap-oer-13-corpus-below-substrate-scale rather than papered over by a larger number here.
_substrate_note: The architecture, the 524288 tokens per step and the one-forward-one-backward rule are NOT duplicated here. They are read from the pristine environment/nanogpt_substrate.json, which is a frozen artifact digested against the submission tree, so there is exactly one declaration of the frozen substrate and no second copy to drift against it.
_holdout_note: The graded split is the verifier's own held-out FineWeb validation shards. The root is pinned here, on the verifier's admin plane, and is resolved from this file and from nowhere else. No submission byte, no agent-visible declaration and no call reachable from the agent container resolves it, and the shards are absent from environment/ by construction.
_anchor_note: The bigram-era reference constant is deliberately absent. It was a measurement of a different model on a different split and carrying it across the re-base would have published a fabricated pilot result. The floor anchor is now established only by the in-run measurement of the reference composition through the identical frozen nanoGPT path, and the checker fails closed on an anchor the live environment did not establish.
reference_anchor_source: measured in-run by the verifier through the identical frozen protocol
